items.title: Harvest a Firecracker Berry
items.detail: Fast travel to Arktos Pharma; harvest quickly before they explode.

items.title: Collect Brain Fungus
items.detail: Found in dark caves like Wendigo Cave, Kerwood Mine, or Abandoned Waste Dump.

items.title: Collect Deathclaw eggs
items.detail: Check the two nests outside Abandoned Waste Dump in The Mire; server hop if needed.

items.title: Complete the Event: "Mischief Night"
items.detail: Event at Rapidan Camp on the hour; light the pyre and follow Eyebot JES-2R.

items.title: Cook Brain Fungus Soup
items.detail: Requires 1 Boiled Water, 1 Brain Fungus, and 1 Wood at a Cooking Station.

items.title: Kill a Lost during the "Mischief Night" Event
items.detail: Kill Lost Dwellers during the Mischief Night event at Rapidan Camp.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find an active Infestation (gray cloudy area on map) and defeat Phantoms inside the hotspot.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Enter build menu and construct basic wood or concrete floors; scrap them for credit.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is reliable.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Fully complete an Infestation event for rare 4-Star legendary loot and exclusive mods.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station; small yield 1, medium yield 2, large yield 5, Axolotl yield 25.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has reliable robot spawns; use energy weapons or V.A.T.S.

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Consume items like BlamCo Mac and Cheese, Dandy Boy Apples, or Pork n' Beans.

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Fast travel to Solomon's Pond; target the eyes with V.A.T.S. for weak spot damage.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event at Rapidan Camp, then stay in Vertibot area for Phantom spawn.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community contest to build slasher-themed C.A.M.P.s or Shelters with prizes including Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event at Rapidan Camp featuring the Eyebot JES-2R and Lost Dwellers; occurs on the hour.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Event providing doubled mutation benefits across all public events and activities.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring spooky-themed Scorched enemies with exclusive rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Weekend event doubling all experience gain from combat, quests, and activities.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chances to catch seasonal fish; does not apply to local legend.
